technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with bullish MACD/stoch crossovers offset by price below key moving averages and weak volume confirmation; moderate confluence but structural headwinds limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: BAC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk with 56 days to next report.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite weak congressional selling and absent news confirmation; AAII bearish dominance (50.4%) reinforces capitulation setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (384.96) combined with flat yield curve and negative macro score (-3) creates severe risk environment; 56-day earnings window provides some buffer but financial sector faces acute credit stress headwinds.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (10/10) with MACD/stoch bullish crossovers and supertrend alignment create classic contrarian capitulation setup near support (29.68), offering asymmetric risk/reward for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely unfavourable with VIX crisis regime (384.96), price structurally below EMA-21/SMA-21, weak volume confirmation (OBV/CMF negative), and 56-day earnings risk in a financial sector facing acute credit stress headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme fear sentiment (10/10) with MACD/stoch bullish crossovers and price at support (29.68) create contrarian setup; however, macro headwinds and weak volume confirmation warrant observation before entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (384.96) combined with negative macro environment (-3) and credit spread stress could trigger further financial sector deterioration despite technical bounce signals.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents bullish on contrarian setup, but fundamental and risk agents strongly bearish on macro/earnings/credit environment
decision.portfolio_note: Already 21 positions in Financials sector; adding BAC would increase concentration risk in unfavourable macro regime — defer entry until macro stabilizes or sector rotation improves.
